result.summary: Found 1 visual layout issue where a restaurant title is clipped mid-character.

issues.description: Under 'Popular right now', the restaurant title 'Tokumaru Ramen' is clipped mid-character on the final 'n', appearing as 'Tokumaru Rameı' despite ample horizontal space between the title and the rating.
issues.suggestion: Expand the title text container width or allow it to flex properly up to the rating element, and apply proper text truncation with an ellipsis if needed rather than hard-clipping.
